title: Artificial Intelligence Engineering, B.S. (College of Engineering)
notes: 8-semester (finishes in 7 simulated terms at this credit load), bulletin-stated 126-127cr program (only one plan variant, no options to choose between). Scraped a new AIE department catalog (AIE 355, AIE 489W -- didn't exist before this build). Three real hidden-prereq/concurrent gaps found, none present anywhere in AIE's own bulletin plan: A-I 305 needs MATH 220 (hard, no alternative) and MATH 231/230 as prereqs; A-I 370 needs STAT 200/DS 200 as a prereq AND one of CMPSC 465/DS 305/CMPSC 462 concurrently (found via a real engine bug hunt -- prereqs_satisfied passed but concurrent_satisfied silently failed, which is what actually diagnoses this class of gap, not just reading the catalog's prereq_groups). Added MATH 220 (2cr, sem2), MATH 231 (2cr, sem3), STAT 200 (4cr, sem1), and CMPSC 462 (3cr, sem4 -- cheapest of the three concurrent options since its own prereqs are already satisfied by CMPSC 132/360/MATH 141 elsewhere in this same plan) to unlock them, same pattern as every other hidden-prereq-chain addition this session -- pushes the computed total to ~137-138cr, documented rather than silently absorbed. Bumped max_credits_per_semester to 21 to keep the resulting load realistic given the additions. 'CMPSC 131 or 121 and DS 120' modeled as two separate items (3cr + 1cr) per real catalog data. Technical Elective / Department List slots have no enumerated list on the bulletin page -- modeled as generic slots, same convention as every other unenumerated elective pool this session. A second post-parens-fix re-scrape (AND/OR prereq-parsing bug fix) revealed STAT 200 (already added above) now itself needs MATH 21, which needs MATH 4, which needs MATH 3 -- none were in the plan, permanently blocking STAT 200 and therefore A-I 370. Also found two more real, independent gaps: CMPSC 448 (needed for A-I 410) requires STAT 319 or STAT 415, neither present -- added STAT 414 (Semester 4, satisfiable via MATH 231) then STAT 415 (Semester 5). CMPSC 462 (added above to unlock A-I 370's concurrent requirement) itself has a fourth AND-group requiring CMPSC 330, not present -- added CMPSC 330 (Semester 3, satisfiable via CMPSC 122/132 alone). Added the real MATH chain explicitly: MATH 3 (Semester 1), MATH 4 (Semester 2), MATH 21 (Semester 3) -- same convention as every other hidden-prereq-chain addition this session (e.g. ABSM, ACCTG, ACTSC, ADPR, AE, AERSP, AGBM, LSCPE).
